note: Starter factor vocabulary. Keys under 'factors' are the ONLY valid Violation.factor values. Agree changes with all three members.

element_density.title: Too many elements on one screen
element_density.fix: Group related elements and move secondary content to another screen or behind progressive disclosure.
element_density.guideline: Material Design — Layout; Nielsen #8 Aesthetic and minimalist design

deep_nesting.title: Deeply nested layer hierarchy
deep_nesting.fix: Flatten the layout: replace nested groups with a few auto-layout containers.

inconsistent_alignment.title: Elements not aligned to a common grid
inconsistent_alignment.fix: Align elements to an 8 pt grid and shared left/right edges.

inconsistent_spacing.title: Irregular spacing between elements
inconsistent_spacing.fix: Apply one spacing scale (4/8/16/24/32) consistently between related and unrelated elements.

excessive_colors.title: Too many distinct colours
excessive_colors.fix: Limit the screen to a primary, secondary and neutral palette and reuse colour styles.

excessive_fonts.title: Too many font sizes or weights
excessive_fonts.fix: Use a type scale with at most 3–4 text styles per screen.

choice_overload.title: Too many choices or actions
choice_overload.fix: Keep one primary action per screen and move secondary actions into a menu or later step.

small_touch_target.title: Touch targets too small
small_touch_target.fix: Make every tappable area at least 44×44 pt (iOS) / 48×48 dp (Android).
small_touch_target.guideline: Apple HIG; Material Design — Touch targets; Fitts's Law

low_contrast.title: Text contrast below WCAG AA
low_contrast.fix: Raise text/background contrast to at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text).

small_text.title: Text too small to read comfortably
small_text.fix: Use at least 16 pt for body text and 12 pt for captions.
small_text.guideline: Apple HIG — Typography; Material Design — Type scale

text_overload.title: Long blocks of text
text_overload.fix: Break text into short chunks with headings, bullet points and clear labels.

weak_visual_hierarchy.title: No clear visual hierarchy
weak_visual_hierarchy.fix: Differentiate headings, primary actions and body text with size, weight and colour.

long_form.title: Too many input fields on one screen
long_form.fix: Split the form into steps, drop optional fields and use smart defaults.
